name: Järnvägsrestaurangen
description: Liseberg's beloved railway-themed family restaurant, where guests sit in restored train carriages and station-style booths while enjoying well-prepared home-style Swedish and international dishes. KRAV-certified at Premium Bronze level, reflecting the restaurant's commitment to sustainably sourced ingredients. A perennial favourite for families needing a proper sit-down meal between rides.

items.description: Classic meatballs with mashed potatoes, lingonberry and cream sauce

items.description: Grilled chicken breast with seasonal vegetables and potatoes

items.name: Pancakes
items.description: Classic Swedish pancakes with jam and cream, child-friendly

name: Al Parco
description: A relaxed Italian restaurant serving fresh pizza, pasta and salads in a bright, casual setting. Al Parco is one of Liseberg's most popular restaurants for groups wanting a reliably good, unfussy meal without the wait of table service, with both pre-booking and drop-in options depending on the day.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Classic tomato and mozzarella pizza from the stone oven

items.name: Pasta Bolognese
items.description: Fresh pasta with a rich Italian meat sauce

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Crisp salad with grilled chicken and parmesan

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Classic Italian dessert

name: Tyrolen
description: A charming Austrian-themed restaurant serving classic Alpine dishes for guests both big and small, complete with cosy chalet-style decor. Tyrolen brings genuine Austrian comfort food to Liseberg, a distinctive change of pace from the park's more typical Scandinavian and international offerings.

items.name: Wiener Schnitzel
items.description: Classic breaded veal or pork schnitzel with lingonberry and potatoes

items.name: Bratwurst

items.name: Apple Strudel
items.description: Traditional Austrian apple strudel with vanilla sauce

name: Hamnkrogen
description: Widely regarded as one of the top three restaurants inside Liseberg, Hamnkrogen is a harbour-themed seafood restaurant serving fresh Swedish west-coast specialties including saltsprinkled mussels and other coastal delicacies. The service and food quality consistently earn it the park's best reviews among sit-down dining options.

name: Lisebergs Wärdshus
description: A traditional Swedish wärdshus (inn) style restaurant serving hearty husmanskost dishes in a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Lisebergs Wärdshus is the destination for guests wanting an authentic taste of classic Swedish home cooking during their visit to the park.
